title: Move the local checkout to cairn and repoint the factory
acceptance: The local checkout is ~/Documents/cairn and git worktree metadata is consistent
The worktree root is ~/Documents/cairn-worktrees and config.json worktree_root agrees
.claude/settings.json permission allowlist points at the new absolute path
Every ledger task whose touches name Stacks/, StacksShareExtension/ or StacksUITests/ is rewritten to the Cairn paths
ledger.sh drift and validate both pass afterwards
The gate passes from the renamed checkout and main-health.sh is green
No factory script, task file, or setting still refers to the old path
notes: NOT AGENT WORK, and not because of policy — an agent cannot rename the directory its own shell is running inside, and every brief it was given carries absolute paths through the old name. This is an overseer operation performed directly, after T-0031 has landed and with an empty fleet. Order matters: (1) confirm no worktrees remain, since git worktree metadata stores absolute paths and a rename orphans them; (2) gh repo rename cairn, which also updates origin; (3) mv ~/Documents/stacks ~/Documents/cairn and mv the worktrees root; (4) update config.json worktree_root and .claude/settings.json allowlist; (5) re-run main-health.sh from the new path to prove the gate still works. The scratchpad and session paths keep the old name and that is harmless — they are session-scoped.

history.detail: added ledger touches rewrite — the rename makes every Stacks/ glob stale, which is the same drift that bit T-0006 and T-0007
GitHub repo already renamed by the owner; origin repointed to the canonical URL. Remaining scope is the local checkout, the worktree root, the settings allowlist and the stale ledger globs.

checkout moved to ~/Documents/cairn, worktrees to ~/Documents/cairn-worktrees, config and allowlist repointed, 6 stale leases rewritten; stale SwiftPM and DerivedData caches cleared (absolute paths baked in), gate green cold from the new home
